region: Hammondsport · Keuka Lake, Finger Lakes, New York
about: Living Roots Wine & Co. was founded in 2016 by Sebastian and Colleen Hardy: Seb a sixth-generation winemaker from South Australia, Colleen a Rochester-area native who left marketing for the cellar. After starting with Rochester’s only urban winery, they built a production winery and tasting room on Colleen’s family’s Shale Creek Vineyard, above Keuka Lake near Hammondsport, where many of their grapes are grown. Their Finger Lakes range sits alongside reds from the Hardy family’s vineyards in the Adelaide Hills.

Blaufränkisch is central Europe’s great cool-climate red: the signature red of Austria’s Burgenland, known as Kékfrankos in Hungary and Lemberger in Germany. It ripens reliably where summers are short, keeps bright acidity, and gives peppery, red- and dark-fruited wines, which has made it one of the Finger Lakes’ most promising red grapes. Living Roots has used it in its pét-nat rosé, and here bottles it on its own from the 2024 vintage. It shows lifted red fruit and spice on the nose, then a juicy palate with a subtle white-pepper note and very fine, delicate tannins: a lighter-bodied red that balances fruit, spice and texture.
